            return

        if bar_end < time(9, 45) or bar_end > time(14, 30):

            self.pending_signal_end_time = bar.end_time

        })

            self.debug("Skipped entry: no call expiration at least seven calendar days away")
            return

        minimum_strike = spy_price * 1.01

        candidates = [

            if contract.right == OptionRight.CALL
            and contract.expiry.date() == selected_expiry

            )
            return

        selected = min(candidates, key=lambda c: (c.strike, str(c.symbol)))
        ticket = self.market_order(selected.symbol, 1)

        self.entry_order_id = ticket.order_id
        self.debug(
            f"Entry submitted: 1 {selected.symbol}, "
            f"expiry {selected.expiry.date()}, strike {selected.strike}"
        )

            return

        if not data.quote_bars.contains_key(self.held_contract):
            return

        quote = data.quote_bars[self.held_contract]
        if quote.bid is None or quote.ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote.bid.close
        ask = quote.ask.close
        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= self.entry_price * 1.50:

        if self.held_contract is None:
            return

        if self.exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        quantity = self.portfolio[self.held_contract].quantity

        ticket = self.market_order(self.held_contract, -quantity)
        self.exit_order_id = ticket.order_id
        self.debug(f"Exit submitted for {self.held_contract}: {reason}")

        exchange_hours = self.securities[self.spy].exchange.hours
        candidate = expiry_date - timedelta(days=1)

                self.debug(

        self.exit_order_id = None

        self.equity_cleanup_order_id = None

    def on_data(self, slice):
        self._handle_unexpected_spy_position()
        self._handle_expiration()
        self._handle_option_exit(slice)
        self._evaluate_pending_entry(slice)

    def _on_five_minute_bar(self, sender, bar):
        previous_fast = self.fast.current.value
        previous_slow = self.slow.current.value
        were_ready = self.fast.is_ready and self.slow.is_ready

        point = IndicatorDataPoint(bar.end_time, bar.close)
        self.fast.update(point)
        self.slow.update(point)

        if not were_ready:
            return

        bar_time = bar.end_time.time()
        eligible_time = time(9, 45) <= bar_time <= time(14, 30)

        crossed_up = (
            previous_fast <= previous_slow
            and self.fast.current.value > self.slow.current.value
        )

        if crossed_up and eligible_time:
            # OnData receives the current minute Slice immediately after this
            # completed consolidated bar is produced.
            self.pending_entry_bar_end = bar.end_time

    def _evaluate_pending_entry(self, slice):
        if self.pending_entry_bar_end is None:
            return

        if self.pending_entry_bar_end != self.time:
            # A signal is only actionable on the Slice immediately following
            # the completed five-minute bar.
            self.pending_entry_bar_end = None
            return

        self.pending_entry_bar_end = None

        if self.time.date() in self.expiration_blocked_dates:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: expiration processing blocked trading today.")
            return

        if self.entry_order_id is not None or self.exit_order_id is not None:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: an option order is already open.")
            return

        if self.held_contract is not None or self.portfolio.invested:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: a position already exists.")
            return

        spy_bar = slice.bars.get(self.spy)
        if spy_bar is None or spy_bar.close <= 0:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: no current SPY TradeBar.")
            return

        chain = slice.option_chains.get(self.option_canonical)
        if chain is None:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: no SPY option chain in current Slice.")
            return

        algorithm_date = self.time.date()
        min_expiry_date = algorithm_date + timedelta(days=7)

        calls = [
            contract for contract in chain
            if contract.right == OptionRight.CALL
        ]

        valid_expirations = sorted({
            contract.expiry.date()
            for contract in calls
            if contract.expiry.date() >= min_expiry_date
        })

        if not valid_expirations:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: no expiration at least seven calendar days away.")
            return

        minimum_strike = 1.01 * spy_bar.close

        candidates = [
            contract for contract in calls
            if contract.expiry.date() == selected_expiry
            and contract.strike >= minimum_strike
        ]

        if not candidates:
            self.debug("Skipped entry: no qualifying call at selected expiration.")
            return

            candidates,

        )[0]

        ticket = self.market_order(selected.symbol, 1)
        self.entry_order_id = ticket.order_id
        self.entry_expiry = selected.expiry.date()

        self.debug(
            f"Entry submitted: {selected.symbol}, strike {selected.strike}, "
            f"expiry {selected.expiry.date()}."
        )

        if self.held_contract is None:
            return

        if not self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested:
            return

        previous_trading_day = (
            self.securities[self.spy]
            .exchange.hours
            .get_previous_trading_day(
                datetime.combine(self.held_expiry, time.min)
            )
            .date()
        )

        if (
            self.time.date() == previous_trading_day
            and self.time.time() == time(15, 45)
        ):
            self._submit_option_exit("time stop before expiration")
            return

        if self.exit_order_id is not None or self.entry_fill_price is None:
            return

        quote = slice.quote_bars.get(self.held_contract)
        if quote is None or quote.bid is None or quote.ask is None:
            return

        bid = quote.bid.close
        ask = quote.ask.close

        if bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return

        midpoint = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if midpoint >= 1.50 * self.entry_fill_price:
            self._submit_option_exit("50% profit target")

    def _handle_expiration(self):
        if self.held_contract is None or self.held_expiry is None:
            return

        if self.time.date() < self.held_expiry:
            return

        self.expiration_blocked_dates.add(self.time.date())

        if self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested:
            self._submit_option_exit("expiration processing safeguard")

    def _submit_option_exit(self, reason):
        if self.held_contract is None or not self.portfolio[self.held_contract].invested:
            return

        if self.exit_order_id is not None:
            return

        for open_order in self.transactions.get_open_orders(self.held_contract):
            self.transactions.cancel_order(open_order.id)

        quantity = self.portfolio[self.held_contract].quantity
        if quantity == 0:
            return

        ticket = self.market_order(self.held_contract, -quantity)
        self.exit_order_id = ticket.order_id
        self.debug(f"Exit submitted ({reason}): {self.held_contract}.")

        if not self.portfolio[self.spy].invested:
            return

        if self.equity_cleanup_order_id is not None:
            return

        quantity = self.portfolio[self.spy].quantity
        ticket = self.market_order(self.spy, -quantity)
        self.equity_cleanup_order_id = ticket.order_id

        self.debug(
            f"Unexpected SPY exercise/assignment position detected; "
            f"liquidation submitted for {quantity} shares."
        )

            self.entry_order_id is not None
            and order_event.order_id == self.entry_order_id
        ):
            if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:

                self.held_expiry = self.entry_expiry
                self.entry_fill_price = order_event.fill_price

                self.debug(
                    f"Entry filled: {self.held_contract} at "
                    f"{self.entry_fill_price:.2f}."
                )

                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.entry_expiry = None

            elif order_event.status in [OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.INVALID]:
                self.debug(f"Entry order was not filled: {order_event.status}.")
                self.entry_order_id = None
                self.entry_expiry = None

        if (
            self.exit_order_id is not None
            and order_event.order_id == self.exit_order_id
        ):
            if order_event.status == OrderStatus.FILLED:
                self.debug(
                    f"Exit filled: {order_event.symbol} at "
                    f"{order_event.fill_price:.2f}."
                )

                self.exit_order_id = None
                self.held_contract = None
